product_overview: Sellora is an AI-powered e-commerce intelligence platform that helps users authenticate, analyze e-commerce data, and monitor competitors. It combines a React frontend with a FastAPI backend and Gemini-powered analysis to deliver actionable insights.
core_goals: Enable secure user sign-up and login
Provide AI-driven analysis of e-commerce data
Track competitor prices and stock over time
Support an e-commerce intelligence workflow through a modern web application

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Allows users to create accounts and securely log in to access the platform.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/signup with valid registration details -> Receive 201 with created user account -> POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token and authenticated session
POST /api/auth/signup with an already registered email -> Receive 409 with an account already exists error
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 with an authentication failed error

features.name: Analysis
features.description: Provides AI-powered analysis of e-commerce data using Gemini to generate insights for users.
user_flows: POST /api/analysis with valid e-commerce data payload -> Receive 200 with AI-generated analysis results from Gemini
POST /api/analysis with malformed or incomplete data -> Receive 400 with validation error details
POST /api/analysis without authentication token -> Receive 401 with unauthorized error

features.name: Competitor Tracking
features.description: Lets users monitor competitor prices and stock levels for selected products and competitors.
user_flows: POST /api/competitors/track with competitor and product details -> Receive 200 confirming tracking is enabled -> GET /api/competitors/status to retrieve current price and stock data -> Receive 200 with competitor tracking results
POST /api/competitors/track with missing competitor information -> Receive 400 with validation error
GET /api/competitors/status for a competitor that is not being tracked -> Receive 404 with competitor tracking not found error

features.name: E-Commerce Intelligence
features.description: Aggregates product, pricing, and market signals into an intelligence workflow that supports decision-making across the platform.
user_flows: GET /api/intelligence/summary with an authenticated user context -> Receive 200 with a consolidated e-commerce intelligence summary
POST /api/intelligence/summary request with invalid filters or unsupported parameters -> Receive 400 with error details
GET /api/intelligence/summary without a valid token -> Receive 401 with unauthorized error
